concept.en: ip rule picks a table before the route lookup

summary.hr: Usmjernik s dvije vanjske veze: pravila po izvoru biraju tablicu, pa isto odredište ide različitim putem. Dodaj pravila i tablice, pošalji s dva izvora.
summary.en: A router with two uplinks: rules on the source pick the table, so one destination takes different paths. Add rules and tables, send from two sources.

title.en: A source rule catches the LAN too

title.en: The reply through the wrong uplink

concept.hr: Bez pravila za vlastiti izvor odgovor ide tablicom main i ISP ga odbacuje
concept.en: Without a rule for its own source the reply follows main and the ISP drops it
